segments.oily: Reviewers do not report oily skin specifically, but several with combination skin say the product feels light and non-greasy rather than heavy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: many say it hydrates well without heaviness and works especially well in winter, while a few say it left them tight, greasy, itchy, or with a chemical smell and not enough overnight hydration.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report it balances dry patches without breaking them out, though one reviewer with dry-combo skin had a bad breakout.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: several say it calms and hydrates without irritation (including rosacea sufferers), while others report burning, itching, or no real benefit for the price.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes it as great for normal to dry skin, hydrating without heaviness and without breakouts.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (mid-40s to 70s) generally report long-term satisfaction, softer skin and help with fine lines, though one 45-year-old with dry skin found it insufficiently hydrating overnight.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging skin report smoother, softer skin and some improvement in fine lines and wrinkles over time; no dissent reported.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it hydrates deeply without feeling heavy, especially in winter or dry climates; a minority say it wasn't moisturizing enough overnight or left skin tight and itchy.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin generally report it soothes redness and irritation, though one sensitive-skin reviewer felt a slight burning sensation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with psoriasis-prone dry patches says it reduced flakiness and helped skin retain moisture; another with sensitive skin describes stinging on already irritated skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with dark spots and deep wrinkles reports overall satisfaction but does not describe a specific effect on spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone or breakout-prone reviewers say it did not cause breakouts and kept skin clear; however, a few reviewers report new breakouts or forehead bumps after use.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers, including those with combination or oily-leaning skin, say it absorbs quickly and does not leave a greasy or oily residue; one reviewer found it left her skin shiny.

aspects.libelle: Good value in larger jumbo size

extraits.texte: I bought this in hopes of improving my dry skin. It did moisturize my skin without it feeling oily. But it made me break out and it smells like chemicals.

I have sensitive irrirated skin and while this moisturizer keeps my skin soft and hydrated, it smells disgusting. It has a very strong chemical odor. It also burns slightly on my skin. The product is expensive, and it's supposed to be made of quality ingredients; this is frustrating to say the least. Especially since so many people recommend this brand.

extraits.titre: Only lotion that works for my skin
extraits.texte: After another brand discontinued the face lotion I used for 10 years, I nearly cried. I have very sensitive, breakout prone, combination skin. Usually when i try a new product, i breakout within a week. THANK GOD for Intensive Moisture Balance from Dermalogica!! I feel so lucky that I took a chance on this and it worked so well. My skin is so hydrated and moisturized, but not overly so in a way that makes me breakout. It truly is the perfect balance. My skin is so clear and just looks healthy. I thought my other product being discontinued would be a nightmare, but really it was a blessing in disguise! Please Dermalogica, keep this one - I promise I will buy it forever!! Nothing else works - and I've tried a LOT.

I have Rosacea, the medication I use has the tendency to dry my skin. Intensive Moisture Balance Moisturizer leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturizer. It is not a heavy moisturizer; it is very light. Suits my needs and will continue to use it.

Perfect for those drier spots who refuse to absorb moisture! It's even helping some of my psoriasis spots be less flakey. I use it in combination with the moisturizing toner and soothing hydrating lotion and it keeps my skin feeling supple for most of the day or night. It does have a slight burn when my skin is especially irritated, but have not noticed any ill effects.

extraits.titre: I have used this product for over 2 years
extraits.texte: I cannot live without this product. I have tried to switch to less pricey options and my skin suffers for it. I know it is on the expensive side but it is worth it. I have incredibly sensitive skin and this has always soothed it while providing great hydration. It is a thicker cream that I feel would be best for dry to combination skin.

extraits.titre: Not moisturizing enough for mature, dry skin
extraits.texte: I'd hoped to use this as a night cream, but it didnt deliver enough hydration over night. I'm 45, with dry skin and live in a dry climate. This one felt nice upon application, but I wake up feeling tight and needing more moisturizer.
